entries.text: Magnet Sort target: PixiJS 8.22.0 with Preact HUD, pure deterministic simulator, one app-owned RAF, pseudo-2.5D layered 2D art; no Three.js migration. For PixiJS 8 tutorials and practical guidance on scene graph, pointer input, assets, performance, cleanup, read docs/knowledge/pixijs-practices.md and docs/design/PIXI_RENDERING.md.
